🍴 Lil' Tex – Local Flavor, Big Heart | Copperas Cove, TX #localfood 

Looking for a great spot to grab a bite and connect with the community? Lil' Tex in Copperas Cove is one of our favorite local gems. With hearty comfort food, friendly service, and a laid-back atmosphere, it’s the kind of place where neighbors gather and conversations flow as easily as the sweet tea.

📍 In this video, Kati Bennett takes you inside Lil' Tex to highlight what makes Copperas Cove such a welcoming place to live. From the food to the people, it’s places like this that give the town its charm—and show why we’re proud to be your neighborhood experts in Central Texas real estate.
